summary.name: Kinetic Typography (Motion Design and Cinematography category). Explicit: the source names this style directly.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: text carries the narrative through size, weight, spacing, position, and movement order. Copy stays concise, actions follow meaning, and clear holds are kept. Alignment and reading continuity are maintained, so letters do not all share identical spring motion.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: quotes, manifestos, and copy-led spots. Compatibility lists UI and product storytelling, editorial and minimalist layouts, and motion posters. Inferred: rhythmic promos or lyric pieces, where timing follows an audio track, fit well.
summary.limitations: Explicit: adapt or omit when recomposition does not clarify the subject, when anchored copy is cropped, or when text lands in unsafe areas. Dense copy needs a rigid grid. Unspecified: duration, aspect ratio, resolution, and frame rate; these are task inputs.
summary.palette: Suggested, not approved: background #FAF5E9 (cream), foreground #252D39 (ink), one warm accent #B84F3F (red). Task-supplied colors override these. No gradient is enabled. Two-color checks: ink on cream 12.757; cream on red 4.565. Recheck actual composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: motion is authored from meaning, with word-level layout changes and deliberate reading holds. Springs, bounce, and extra in-betweens are not added automatically. Video runs from composition time; live scroll or pointer input applies only to interactive delivery. Optional motion-007, -012, and -015 apply only where a scene supports them.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style: no mandatory music, voice, genre, or tempo. Audio is inferred per topic and audience; user audio requirements come first. Pairing with style-105 would map word entrances to a supplied track's beats. Verify speech intelligibility, balance, absence of clipping, and picture sync.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicit: load and measure actual fonts before layout; group words or glyphs; convert lettering to verified paths only when shape deformation is required. Exact copy and approved assets must be supplied; missing assets remain unspecified and should be reported. Photography is unspecified, and style-001 advises against it.
summary.combinations: Stands alone for copy-led work. Optional: style-105 adds beat-mapped timing with the accent reserved for stressed words, for lyric or spoken-word pieces with a supplied track. style-001 adds a Swiss grid with baseline alignment, using only cream, ink, red, and one sans family, with no diagonal free motion.
summary.productionApproach: Explicit: HTML/CSS and SVG render text and shapes. One motion owner per property drives animation, using GSAP as the required paused timeline clock; Motion, mo.js, ScrambleTextPlugin, or Anime.js are optional. HyperFrames handles assembly, timing, and export by default; Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation applies.
